title: The changelog rule in CLAUDE.md does not spell out the Keep a Changelog headings
body:
`CLAUDE.md` says the changelog follows Keep a Changelog, and it names none of the headings. A reader has to look them up outside the repository, and a bug fix can end up under `### Changed`.

## Proposal

- `CLAUDE.md` names every Keep a Changelog heading, in its order: `### Added`, `### Changed`, `### Deprecated`, `### Removed`, `### Fixed` and `### Security`. It says a bug fix goes under `### Fixed`, never under `### Changed`.
- An audit of the changelogs of `crates/acre`, `crates/acre-cli` and `crates/acre-gui` moves each bug fix filed under `### Changed` to a `### Fixed` section. It covers every release and `## [Unreleased]`.
- An entry that holds both a design change and a fix is split. The fix becomes its own entry under `### Fixed`.
